lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular nodes are arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The primary visible cluster consists of roughly four vertical columns, each containing 3 to 4 spots, forming a semi-regular rectangular grid on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity relative to the dark background traverse the flank; high-intensity circular blobs are positioned at the approximate intersections of these vertical bands and faint horizontal lines of similar luminance.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal linear features are visible on the upper lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side and low-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense aggregation of small, low-contrast elongated pixel clusters is visible immediately ventral to the pectoral fin, indicating the presence of secondary biological entities.
